payload.name: Photo 400x514 Under 100KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 400 x 514 photo workflow for 100KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 400 x 514 photo under 100KB workflow for portals that require exact portrait pixels plus a 100KB cap. It points to local resize and image-to-KB compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
